# discord_channel (Data Source)

Looks up a server channel by ID or name. The bot must be able to view the channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_channel" "general" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  name      = "general"
  type      = "text"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the channel. Exactly one of `id` or `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Name of the channel. The lookup fails if no channel or more than one has this name.
- `type` (String) Channel type: `text`, `voice`, `category`, `announcement`, `stage`, `forum` or `media`. When looking up by name, only channels of this type match.

### Read-Only

- `category_id` (String) Parent category ID.
- `nsfw` (Boolean) Whether the channel is age-restricted.
- `position` (Number) Sort position.
- `topic` (String) Channel topic.
